result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，以零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置评估其性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空等多项 NLP 数据集上取得较强表现，少样本设置下有时可与甚至偶尔超过此前最优的微调方法 [abstract][S1.p11]。模型还能完成需要即时推理或领域适应的任务，如解乱序单词、使用新词造句和三位数算术 [abstract][S1.p12]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法论问题 [abstract][S1.p13]。作者认为这些结果表明超大规模语言模型可能是开发可适应、通用语言系统的重要组成部分 [S8.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调的范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万条任务特定标注数据进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模监督数据集限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需简短指令或极少量示例就能完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模能否大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model

method.text: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大者称为 GPT-3，架构与 GPT-2 相同但使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力 [S2.SS1.p1]。训练数据以过滤后的 Common Crawl 为主，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。评估时不做梯度更新或微调，而是通过文本交互给出任务描述和少量示例，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning
the model is given a few demonstrations of the task at inference time as conditioning, but no weight updates are allowed

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在零样本、单样本和少样本三种条件下测试 [S1.p9]。少样本设置中示例数 K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型 2048 token 上下文窗口限制 [S2.p2][S2.SS4.p2]。评估覆盖语言建模与完形填空、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成与定性任务 [S3.p3]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions
We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100
the maximum amount allowed by the model’s context window, which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models
In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks

findings.text: GPT-3 在多项任务上取得较强结果：零样本 CoQA 达 81.5 F1，少样本达 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；TriviaQA 少样本达 71.2%，在闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到当时最优 [S1.p11]。在 LAMBADA 上零样本达 76%，比此前最优提升 8% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1]，少样本达 86.4%，提升超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。在需要即时推理的任务上，GPT-3 少样本在 2 位数加法上达 100% 准确率，2 位数减法 98.9%，3 位数加法 80.2%，3 位数减法 94.2% [S3.SS9.SSS1.p4]。新闻生成方面，人类识别 GPT-3 175B 生成文章的准确率仅约 52%，接近随机水平 [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。但论文也发现少样本在 ANLI、RACE、QuAC 等任务上仍表现不佳 [S1.p13]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
GPT-3 achieves 64.3% accuracy on TriviaQA in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting
in a zero-shot setting GPT-3 achieves 76% on LAMBADA, a gain of 8% over the previous state of the art
GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
achieving 100% accuracy on 2 digit addition, 98.9% at 2 digit subtraction, 80.2% at 3 digit addition, and 94.2% at 3-digit subtraction
mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$
we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3

limitations.text: 作者明确承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及在“常识物理”类问题上存在困难 [S5.p2]。在部分“比较”类任务上，GPT-3 单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机，如 WiC 和 ANLI，以及部分阅读理解任务 [S5.p2]。结构上，论文只研究自回归模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能牺牲了在填空、回看比较内容等任务上的表现 [S5.p3]。此外，预训练目标本身可能触及极限，且模型在预训练阶段样本效率较差 [S5.p4][S5.p5]。作者还指出，少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是识别训练中已见过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
GPT-3 seems to have special difficulty with “common sense physics”
it does little better than chance when evaluated one-shot or even few-shot on some “comparison” tasks
our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits
Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
